subject: maths
question: 32 kg of sugar costing Rs. 24 per kg is mixed with 24 kg of sugar costing Rs. 31 per kg. What is the cost of the mixture?
solution:
**Given:**

Weight of first type of sugar = 32 kg

Cost of first type of sugar = Rs. 24 per kg

Weight of second type of sugar = 24 kg

Cost of second type of sugar = Rs. 31 per kg

**Formula Used:**

Cost of the mixture = (Total cost of sugar) / (Total weight of sugar)

**Calculation:**

Total cost of first type of sugar = 32 × 24

Total cost of first type of sugar = Rs. 768

Total cost of second type of sugar = 24 
× 31

Total cost of second type of sugar = Rs. 744

Total cost of the mixture = 768 + 744

Total cost of the mixture = Rs. 1512

Total weight of the mixture = 32 + 24

Total weight of the mixture = 56 kg

Cost of the mixture = 1512 / 56

Cost of the mixture = Rs. 27 per kg

**The cost of the mixture is Rs. 27 per kg.**
